160180101.text: Ad astra abyssosque! How can the Adventurers' Guild help you today?

160180102.text: It's been a while since we last came to see you! Got any exciting commissions for us?

160180103.text: Things have been rather quiet in Nod-Krai lately. The commissions currently on our books are all very routine.

160180104.text: That being said, the Frostmoon Scions are preparing to host some sort of event. They have approached us with quite a number of requests for supplies. Apparently, it's going to be quite a large gathering.

160180105.text: The Frostmoon Scions? Well, it can't be another Moon-Prayer Night... Do they have some other big festival that Paimon doesn't know about?

160180106.text: I heard it's a friendly sparring competition for animal friends. Something called the "Spirit Envoy Championship."

160180109.text: That's right. The Frostmoon Scions have always advocated coexistence with nature, encouraging their followers to build positive relationships with the beasts of the wild.

160180110.text: At the same time, to ensure their animal friends build the strength to withstand hardship and disasters, they put select animals with whom they share a special bond through a unique sort of training.

160180111.text: The "Spirit Envoy Championship" is designed to find the strongest human-animal pair by means of friendly sparring.

160180112.text: In previous years, the competition was restricted to the Frostmoon Scions only, but this year, participants from all over Teyvat are invited to join. I understand that the Frostmoon Scions have even prepared a generous prize for the winner.

160180113.text: Ooh... Does that mean we can join, too?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Speranza and find the mysterious Advisor

160180201.text: Alright then! Next, let's go over some more tips for adventuring in Nod-Krai.

160180202.text: If you found yourself getting hungry in the wild, what are some things you could eat?

160180203.text: That's easy — Lakkaberries, Midsommar Berries... There's loads of options.

160180206.text: That must be who Katheryne was talking about... She looks pretty young for an advisor, though. How knowledgeable can she really be?

160180207.text: But there are plenty of places where berries don't grow, right? What should we be looking for in those places, Miss Linnea?

160180208.text: Good question — I'm glad you asked. That's exactly what I wanted to talk about next. Does everyone recognize this mushroom?

160180209.text: Hmm... Based on the color... this is an edible one, right? Doesn't look poisonous to me...

160180211.text: This here is a Browncap Mushroom. It looks harmless enough, but eating it will give you hallucinations.

160180212.text: An unsuspecting adventurer once used a handful of these to make a pot of mushroom soup. Next thing you know, he was trying to foxtrot with the Wild Hunt... Luckily, he was spotted by a fisherman passing by who managed to save his life, but it was a close call.

160180214.text: You bet! Adventuring in the wild is no joke. Alright, onto the next — does anyone recognize this plant? Can you tell me if it's edible?

160180215.text: Isn't that a Winter Icelea leaf?

160180216.text: They say that the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak are sworn enemies. If Midsommar Berries are sweet and delicious, I guess Winter Icelea leaves must be horribly bitter...

160180217.text: Hmph, Paimon knows the answer to this one! Winter Icelea leaves might not taste good in food, but you can brew a nice tea with them!

160180221.text: At the Flagship. Once when Paimon was eating some yummy food there, Demyan mentioned that one of the drinks in their Roulette Special has Winter Icelea in it.

160180223.text: ...Looks like we have an expert attending our Q&A session today! Well, I hope you're ready for the next question?

160180226.text: Every adventurer knows to pack a compass and a map before heading into the wilderness, but where would you go to buy these things?

160180227.text: Ahem! Listen up, everyone! The answer is... the Adventurers' Guild!

160180228.text: Oh, really? But I hear Mimisbrunnr Books sells them too. And at a very low price!

160180229.text: Hah! Paimon's done her research. The boss of that place tries to pass off cheap knockoffs as the real deal — don't be fooled!

160180230.text: Well said. But even with a high-quality map and compass, the wild can still be a dangerous place. What should you do if you're being chased by a monster you can't fight off?

160180231.text: Seek help from the ratniki on patrol.

160180232.text: Correct! Although the ratniki's main duty is to deal with the Wild Hunt, you can always ask them for help if you run into serious trouble.

160180233.text: While we're on the subject, some adventurers have found they can use the territorial nature of Radiant Beasts to their advantage. Lure a monster into their territory, and they will fight each other instead of you. I wouldn't recommend doing this, though, as you may instead find yourself fighting two enemies instead of one.

160180234.text: Final question! This is an important one. Which place in Nod-Krai is an absolute must-visit for travelers from abroad?

160180236.text: Oof, that's a tough choice! There's the Frostmoon Enclave, Starsand Shoal, Blue Amber Lake... They're all so pretty! Then there's the Voynich Guild, The Flagship... And so many other shops worth visiting!

160180237.text: In truth, there's no right answer to this question. But if you ask me, the place most worth visiting is right here — Speranza.

160180238.text: Why? Simple — this was once my home. So, this final question was more like a little bit of shameless self-promotion, hehe.

160180239.text: You can get delicious Nod-Krai Hot Dogs and Lakkaberry Madames. And if you're not too hungry, just order a slice of Midsommar Torte and listen to the entertaining rumors the children like to tell.

160180240.text: That's it for today's lecture. Tomorrow, I'll be heading to the Frostmoon Enclave to take part in a competition. If you have any questions, you can ask at the Adventurers' Guild, where the other advisors will be happy to help.

160180301.text: I haven't met many adventurers who can keep up with me. Consider me impressed!

160180302.text: Likewise! You really know your stuff! You're everything Paimon would expect from an Adventurers' Guild advisor... Huh!?

160180303.text: #What's the deal!? Don't get so close! {NICKNAME}, there's something wrong with her!

160180304.text: Hehehe... Actually, I was going to ask...

160180305.text: Your little friend is so clever and cute. I love how she flies around, too. Can I pet her?

160180307.text: Don't be afraid. Hehe, I'm not gonna hurt you. Come on, come here...

160180310.text: Hehe... Ahem. I'm sorry, I got a little bit carried away again.

160180311.text: My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild. Uh... And I promise you, I'm not some sort of weirdo!

160180312.text: ...Lemme make it up to you. You want something to eat? Here, try some Midsommar Torte, it's delicious.

160180313.text: Phew, you gave Paimon a fright... Paimon's never met someone so, uh... how to put this... "enthusiastic" as you.

160180314.text: I was fighting to keep a lid on my curiosity during class, but then I just lost control...

160180315.text: Anyway, let's get this back on track. Could you tell me your story? How did you two meet?

160180316.text: (You tell Linnea how you and Paimon met...)

160180317.text: What? You fished this little cutie out of the sea?

160180318.text: Can you tell me where? A visit to that beach is going right to the top of my bucket list.

160180319.text: You'd be wasting your time — Paimon is one of a kind! You could sit on that beach for a hundred years, but you'd still come away empty-handed!

160180320.text: Ah... Is that right? What a pity.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the arena at the Frostmoon Enclave

160180401.text: Whoa, Paimon wasn't expecting this many people...

160180402.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! What a nice surprise! I didn't think I'd run into you here!

160180403.text: Oh, and Professor Linnea's here too! Are you guys here for the competition as well?

160180405.text: Feels like we haven't seen you in ages, Mualani! So how do you know Linnea, anyway?

160180406.text: Through her work with the Adventurers' Guild. She was in Natlan not long ago. She knows so much that we took to calling her "Professor."

160180407.text: Speaking of which, you never answered my question... If a koholasaurus and a qucusaurus got together, would their babies be able to fly in the sky and dive underwater? 'Cause that would make a pretty awesome saurian companion!

160180408.text: That's almost certainly impossible... They're completely different species...

160180409.text: Ah, well, that's too bad. Hear that, Mamala? Guess I can't do any match-making for you in the Flower-Feather Clan after all...

160180411.text: So you have a thing for qucusaurs!?

160180412.text: Hahahaha! I was wonderin' what all the commotion was. Looks like this is where it's at!

160180413.text: Itto!? What the heck? Either Paimon's seeing things, or... You're not here for the competition too, are you?

160180414.text: Why else would I be here? Cost me an arm and a leg to get a boat all the way to this "Krod-Nai" place.

160180416.text: #Hey there! I'm Mualani. Are you a friend of {NICKNAME} and Paimon's, too?

160180417.text: I sure am. Nice to meet ya! The name's Arataki "Beetle Gladiator" Itto, head honcho of the world-famous Arataki Gang of Inazuma!

160180419.text: (Wait, did he say "Arataki Gang"? Why does that sound so familiar...?)

160180420.text: Just call him Arataki Itto. This guy's a bona-fide buffoon.

160180421.text: Hey! Who are you callin' a buffoon, ya flying Lavender Melon!

160180422.text: ...Flying Lavender Melon? Wait, so you're some sort of... mutated lavender melon? You don't look like a melon...

160180423.text: Paimon's not a mutated melon! Or any kind of melon! How could a melon be this cute?

160180426.text: Yeah, about that... Unfortunately, the gang only had the funds to send their main man this time. But don't sweat it! Once I snag that championship title, I'll use the prize money to bring Shinobu and the boys over to join the party!

160180427.text: Shinobu...? Ah! I remember now! Kuki Shinobu, right? She's mentioned the Arataki Gang before.

160180428.text: Huh? No way, you've met my deputy?

160180429.text: She stopped by the Flower-Feather Clan recently to take the flying trial. Chasca said she was a natural!

160180430.text: ...Hold on, if she's that good and she's only the deputy... you must be way stronger than I imagined. Look sharp, Mamala — we're in for a tough competition!

160180431.text: Hahahaha! That's right! Bring it on — I'm looking forward to seeing who I'll be facing in the finals.

160180432.text: Word is that the early birds get the best draws. You snooze you lose! Laters, compadres!

160180433.text: Wait, is he serious? ...Mamala, we'd better hurry!

subQuests.subQuestName: Sign up for the Spirit Envoy Championship

160180501.text: Thank you all for signing up for the "Spirit Envoy Championship."

160180502.text: Due to the high number of participants, a preliminary qualifying round will be held to determine which 16 contestants will progress to the competition itself. Prior to the semi-finals, all matchups will be determined by drawing lots.

160180503.text: Please also note that there are two arenas, which will be randomly assigned after the draw. Do you have any questions?

160180504.text: Where do we go to draw lots?

160180505.text: Right here. After registration closes tomorrow, make your way here to draw lots for the qualifiers. I wish you all the best of luck in the competition!

160180508.text: Lumi, Aguara, how you doing? Nervous?

subQuests.subQuestName: Draw lots for the preliminary round

160180601.text: Who do you think our first opponent is gonna be?

160180602.text: Paimon hopes they aren't too strong... Aguara might need some time to ease into it.

160180603.text: Oh! The results of the draw are out! Let's take a look... Your opponent is:

160180604.text: "Arataki 'Numero Uno' Itto"!? Ugh, we literally just managed to get rid of him, and now you have to face him in the arena?

160180605.text: ...Looks like we won't be facing him in the finals then.

160180606.text: Uh... Well, either way, it never pays to underestimate your opponent, okay? This is your first match, so be sure to make it count!

160180608.text: Ahh, I see you've been assigned to Arena 1. I'm in Arena 2. Guess I'll see you after the match.

160180609.text: Good luck! Don't fall at the first hurdle now!

160180610.text: We won't! Good luck to you and Lumi, too!

160180701.text: Welcome, spectators! I'm your host, Czeslawa. The qualifiers are about to begin. I trust everyone has found their groupings.

160180702.text: #The contestants for this match are: {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} partner Aguara, versus... uhh... Arataki "Numero Uno" Itto and his partner Crimson Staff!

160180703.text: Hahahaha! Well, this has come sooner than expected. I was hoping to face you further into the competition.

160180705.text: You can do it, Aguara! You show that beetle who's boss!

160180707.text: Great energy from both contestants! Now, without further ado, let the match commence!

160180803.text: How did you know I was gonna—

160180808.text: Ignorance really is bliss, isn't it Linnea... But it won't last forever...

160180809.text: (Why is she staring at Linnea? Do they know each other?)

160180810.text: And it's all over! We have a winner!

160180811.text: Congratulations to Linnea and Lumi! You're through to the next round!

160180812.text: I can't believe it... My Iku-Turso...

160180815.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, how did your match go?

160180817.text: You and Lumi were really in sync.

160180818.text: Thanks, that means a lot! Yeah, I think we performed pretty well out there. Not just Lumi — I was really in the zone today.

160180819.text: I dunno how to explain it, but... Sometimes, it feels like I can predict my opponent's next move. I know exactly what to do before I've even had the time to think.

160180820.text: It's almost like I enter a different state of mind. It comes and goes, but it started after I met Lumi in the tundra... Anyway, congrats to both of us on getting through the qualifiers!

160180821.text: Come on, let's head to Speranza — my treat.

160180904.text: Hahahaha! How 'bout that, huh? Victory for Arataki "The One and Oni" Itto!

160180906.text: Uhh, the bull... Ushi, was it?

160180907.text: Uh, yeah... Is there a problem?

160180908.text: #Arataki Itto is disqualified for fielding an additional animal companion. {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

160180910.text: It's one animal per contestant, that's the rule! Let this be a warning to everyone.

160180911.text: But... but me, Crimson Staff, and Ushi are one! We should only count as one contestant! Hey! Ah, come on...!

160181003.text: Uhh, the bull... Ushi, was it?

160181004.text: Uh, yeah... Is there a problem?

160181005.text: #Arataki Itto is disqualified for fielding an additional animal companion. {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

160181007.text: It's one animal per contestant, that's the rule! Let this be a warning to everyone.

160181008.text: But... but me, Crimson Staff, and Ushi are one! We should only count as one contestant! Hey! Ah, come on...!

160181105.text: Uhh, the bull... Ushi, was it?

160181106.text: Uh, yeah... Is there a problem?

160181107.text: #Arataki Itto is disqualified for fielding an additional animal companion. {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

160181109.text: It's one animal per contestant, that's the rule! Let this be a warning to everyone.

160181110.text: But... but me, Crimson Staff, and Ushi are one! We should only count as one contestant! Hey! Ah, come on...!

160181201.text: Woohoo, you've got some moves, I'll give you that! But it's gonna take more than that to defeatto the Itto!

160181202.text: It's time to unleash our show-stopping killer combo move! Ushi! Crimson Staff!

160181203.text: Crimson Staff, look, I wanted to kit you out with mecha armor, but you need to bulk up first. That's why we've gotta take on these tough opponents — to get you strong!

160181204.text: Ushi, you and me have crushed countless foes in our time. Now, with the three of us together, ain't no one gonna stand in our way!

160181502.text: No way, my Sharky Surfboard clearly beat you to it!

160181503.text: Hahahaha! Well, I'll see you in the arena! Just don't go crying like a baby when you lose.

160181504.text: Did you hear that, Mamala? Argh, show them no mercy!

160181604.text: Ahem, I'll have you know it's "Champion" Jahoda.

160181606.text: Don't you know? This isn't my first Spirit Envoy Championship. Uh-huh, I took part in the last one... And not just that — I only went and won the entire competition! It was very heroic.

160181607.text: (Although, there were nowhere near as many contestants then... Ugh, why did so many people have to show up this time!? How am I gonna keep my title now?)

160181608.text: Whoa, that's amazing! We'll definitely have to learn a thing or two from you.

160181701.text: This is the biggest turnout we've ever had by far. We need to be extra vigilant to maintain order in the arenas.

160181702.text: I've made all the necessary arrangements.

160181703.text: I'm feeling more nervous than I expected...

160181704.text: Don't worry, you'll be fine once you get into the swing of it.

160181705.text: Thank you all for your support. Be sure to let me know at once if any issues arise.

160182101.text: I—I can't believe it... My glorious journey ended at the first step...

160182102.text: It's your own fault for not reading the rules...

160182104.text: Ushi, Crimson Staff... Are you guys tryin' to cheer me up? Well, don't you worry! We'll come back stronger than ever next time, and I'll lead us to a glorious victory, fair and square!

160182105.text: Anyway, seeing as we came all this way, I think a little sightseeing is in order! Hahaha, let's go get ourselves a taste of Krod-Krai culture!

160182107.text: Do you actually have any Mora left?

160182109.text: Ahem... Hey, Lavender Melon! I've got a little, uh, proposition for ya—

160182110.text: No way! If you want Mora, go earn it like everyone else!

160182112.text: Pffft, fine, don't lend me anything then! Watch me, I'll figure something out. This is a small pond — and Arataki Itto is the biggest fish around!
